title: astragalus missouriensis var. accumbens
intro: Astragalus missouriensis var. accumbens, commonly known as Missouri milkvetch, is a perennial legume native to North America. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is used to enhance immune function, reduce inflammation, and improve overall health. The health benefits of Missouri milkvetch include its ability to boost immune system function, reduce stress, and exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of tonifying the Qi and nourishing the body. The bioactive constituents of Missouri milkvetch include saponins, flavonoids, alkaloids, and polysaccharides, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
